svg.text: Route map: one address for one screen
Concepts 3–4 · React Router 8.5.0 declarative mode · every <Route> is written in one place: App.tsx
Above the route tree: mounted ONCE, not swapped when you switch screens
reads the address in the address bar;
one socket for every screen; lab: 10×
Login (email + password); if already logged in, on to the destination
RequireLogin route guard: a layout route without path, wrapping every screen inside it
"loading" → Checking the session… · not logged in → <Navigate to="/login" replace state={{ from: location }} /> · logged in → <Outlet />
Layout the frame of every screen after login; GET /devices once here
header (title, Live badge, Devices | Rules menu, name (role), Log out) · ToastRegion · <Outlet />
Details + chart + gauges; control buttons for admin only
Automation rules in sentences; a viewer only reads
AdminOnly the second guard: admin → <Outlet />; viewer → the Admin only screen (not the form)
Page not found + the link To the device list (outside the guards)
Example: someone who is not logged in opens a direct link to a guarded screen
Screen addresses and API addresses: /devices = the screen on port 5173; /devices = the backend API on port 8080 — the same words, a different origin.
F5 on a deep address works: Vite (dev and preview) sends the same index.html (SPA fallback); other servers need the same rule (Modules 26–27).
<NavLink to="/devices"> without end: the Devices menu stays active on Details.
